flashcards.front: Why does cryptographic hashing fail against polymorphic malware?
flashcards.back: Due to the avalanche effect in hash algorithms: mutating even a single byte or register completely changes the output hash, rendering static blocklists useless.

flashcards.front: What does a shallow average path length E(h(x)) signify in an Isolation Forest?
flashcards.back: It signifies an anomaly! Sparse outliers isolate in very few random partition cuts, yielding short paths and an anomaly score s approaching 1.

flashcards.front: What is an IDN Homoglyph attack?
flashcards.back: An attack where malicious domains substitute visual look-alike Unicode characters (such as Cyrillic 'а') in place of standard Latin characters to deceive users.

flashcards.front: Distinguish between Keystroke Dwell Time and Flight Time.
flashcards.back: Dwell time = duration key remains depressed (down to up). Flight time = transition latency between releasing key n and depressing key n+1.

flashcards.front: Why is PR-AUC preferred over ROC-AUC for credit card fraud models?
flashcards.back: In extreme class imbalance (e.g. 0.05% fraud), ROC-AUC is overly optimistic because massive true-negative numbers distort the false positive rate; PR-AUC focuses strictly on the minority positive class.

formulaSheet.name: Shannon Entropy
formulaSheet.description: Measures uncertainty/randomness in byte sequences. Plaintext ~3.0 - 5.0, Encrypted/Compressed Malware > 7.5 bits/byte.

formulaSheet.name: Isolation Forest Anomaly Score
formulaSheet.description: Normalized score where E(h(x)) is average path length and c(n) is average BST depth. s > 0.8 flags severe anomalies.

formulaSheet.name: TF-IDF Weighting
formulaSheet.formula: \text{TF-IDF}(t, d, D) = \text{TF}(t, d) \times \log\left(\frac{N}{1 + |\{d \in D : t \in d\}|}\right)
formulaSheet.description: Identifies discriminative vocabulary in phishing emails vs standard enterprise corporate traffic.

formulaSheet.name: Mahalanobis Distance (Keystroke Biometrics)
formulaSheet.description: Measures distance of a user's session typing vector from historical baseline while accounting for inter-key covariance.

formulaSheet.name: F-Beta Measure (Security Evaluation)
formulaSheet.description: Use beta = 2 (F2-score) to weight Recall twice as heavily as Precision when missing a threat is far costlier than an alert.
